spirit:field.spirit:description: Enables Auto Draining of Frames from FIFO Interface when the MAC receiver is in Fault state.

spirit:field.spirit:name: disfcschk
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set, the UMAC doesn't perform FCS Checking on the incoming frames for this Channel and the CRC Error status is not set for any of the frames. When reset, the UMAC operates normally and checks FCS on every incoming frame, for this Channel. Frames with CRC Errors are reported in the Frame Status.

spirit:field.spirit:name: stripfcs
spirit:field.spirit:description:
When set, the FCS field is stripped of the frame before the Frame is transferred to the Application logic for this Channel's frames. The Frame Length field is updated to reflect the new length (without the FCS field). When reset, the FCS field is not stripped and is part of the frame that is transferred to Application logic.
Irrespective of the Strip FCS field, FCS Checking is performed on every frame unless Disable FCS Check is set. When theFCS field is checked, the CRC Error status is reported for every frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: vlanchk
spirit:field.spirit:description:
Per the IEEE 802.3 specification, the minFrameSize and maxFrameSize values for untagged frames are set to 64 bytes and 1518 bytes respectively. The values for tagged (VLAN Tagged) frame sizes are updated to account for 4-bytes of VLAN Tag and the maxFrameSize value is updated to 1522 Bytes.
The UMAC supports up to 3 VLAN Tags per frame. It can adjust the maxFrameSize field to support up to 3 VLAN Tags (12 Bytes), based on the number of VLAN tags that are present in the incoming frame. This helps in false MaxFrameSize violation reporting for frames with VLAN tags that exceed 1518 bytes but are under the 1518+tagbytes in length.
The UMAC will use the value programmed in this field to determine the number of VLAN's for which the MAC will check (for this Channel) and update the MaxFrameSize field accordingly.
2'b00: Disable VLAN Checking. 2'b01: Check for up to 1 VLAN Tag (Use the VLAN Tag#1 Register) 2'b10: Check for up to 2 VLAN Tags (Use VLAN Tag#1 and #2 Registers) 2'b11: Check for up to 3 VLAN Tags (Use VLAN Tag#1, #2, and #3Registers)

spirit:field.spirit:name: promiscuous
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set, the UMAC disables address checking on all frames that are received on this Channel, and all the frames received on this channel are passed onto the FIFO Interface. The Frame Status reflects the status of the Address Checking. When the bit is cleared, the DA field is compared against the contents of the MAC Address Register (for Unicast Frames) and the Multicast Hash table (for Multicast Frames). Frames that fail topass the Address filtering will be dropped and not transferred to the FIFO Interface

spirit:field.spirit:name: enrxfcdec
spirit:field.spirit:description:
When set, the UMAC Core is enabled for Flow-Control decode operation for this Channel and it will decode all the incoming frames for PAUSE Control Frames as specified in the IEEE 802.3 Specification.
If the UMAC Core receives a valid PAUSE Control Frame, it will disable the transmission of user data frames for the time given in the PAUSE_TIME field of the PAUSE Control Frame.
If the UMAC Core receives a valid Priority PAUSE Control Frame, it will load the timers and providethe XOFF indication to the Application logic (ff_rxch0pfcxoff[7:0]) based on the Time Vector fields in the 8 priorities.
When reset, the Flow-Control Operation in the UMAC is disabled for this Channel, and it does not decode the frames for PAUSE Control Frames or Priority Pause Flow Control Frames.

spirit:field.spirit:name: prelength
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This defines the START/PREAMBLE/SFD length that is expected of all the frames received on this Channel.
1'b0: Default 8-bytes (START, 6 bytes of PREAMBLE, 1 byte of SFD) 1'b1: 4-bytes (START, 2 bytes of PREAMBLE, 1 byte of SFD).
This is applicable when the Channel is operating at 10G rates and above.

spirit:field.spirit:name: filterpf
spirit:field.spirit:description:
When this bit is set, the UMAC will filter out the frames with DA matching the reserved Multicast PAUSE Control Frame address (01:80:C2:00:00:01) from being sent to the Application Logic.
When this bit is reset, the UMAC does not filter out the frames with the DA matching the reserved Multicast PAUSE Control Frame address (01:80:C2:00:00:01).
This bit has no effect on actual processing/decoding on the PAUSE (Priority PAUSE) Control frames, which is controlled thru theEnable Rx Flow Control Decode bit.
When the PAUSE control frames are passed to the application logic, (Filter PAUSE Frames) is not set, but the application logic can still identify the PAUSE Control frames using Bit[31] in ff_rxsts that is sent out with the frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: enearlyeofdet
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This should be set only when the UMAC is configured for 4x10G mode and the Low Latency option is selected in the PCS. This enables the detection of Early EOF indication from PCS which helps in reducing the latency.
Note: This is to be set only when the UMAC is operating in 4x10G Mode. Setting this in other modes will cause the UMAC to have unexpected behavior.

spirit:field.spirit:name: maxfrmsize
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field determines the Maximum Frame Size for untagged frames that is used in checking the MaxFrameLength violations on this Channel. For frames larger than this value, the MaxFrameLength Error bit is set in the Frame Status.

spirit:field.spirit:name: maxtxjabsize
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This field determines the Jabber Size for the outgoing (Transmit) frames on this Channel. When the length of the current outgoing frame on this Channel exceeds the value programmed in this field, the Frame is considered a Jabber Frame and is truncated at that point with EOF-ERROR. The PHY will eventually force ERROR code onto the line. This will limit the frame transmission run-off in case of Application logic error.
This value has to be a multiple of the Data path width (in bytes) inside the MAC , per the following: 100G: Multiple of 16 40G: Multiple of 8 10G: Multiple of 4 1G: Multiple of 1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: maxrxjabsize
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This field determines the Jabber Size for the incoming (Receive) frames on this Channel. When the length of the current incoming frame on this Channel equals or exceeds the value programmed in this field, the Frame is considered a Jabber Frame and istruncated at that point. The Frame Status is updated with a Jabber Error and the rest of the Jabbered frame that is being received is ignored.
This value has to be a multiple of the Data path width (in bytes) inside the MAC,per the following: 100G: Multiple of 16 40G: Multiple of 8 10G: Multiple of 4 1G: Multiple of 1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txpfcvec
spirit:field.spirit:description: Each bit in this field determines whether the Priority is enabled or disabled for monitoring PFC transmission. This field is also transmitted in the Priority Vector field in the PFC Pause Frame.

spirit:field.spirit:name: vlantag1
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field is used to identify the first VLAN Tag in the incoming frames on this Channel. This helps in programming the outer VLAN Tag based on Application requirements.

spirit:field.spirit:name: vlantag2
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field is used to identify the second VLAN Tag in the incoming frames on this Channel. This helps in programming the inner VLAN Tag based on Application requirements.

spirit:field.spirit:name: vlantag3
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field is used to identify the third VLAN Tag in the incoming frames on this Channel. This helps in programming the innermost VLAN Tag based on Application requirements.

spirit:field.spirit:name: macaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the first Byte of this Channel's MAC Address as it appears on the Receiving Frame in the DA Field. This is used for Address filtering when enabled.

spirit:field.spirit:name: macaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the third Byte of this Channel's MAC Address as it appears on the Receiving Frame in the DA Field. This is used for Address filtering when enabled.

spirit:field.spirit:name: macaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the fifth Byte of this Channel's MAC Address as it appears on the Receiving Frame in the DA Field. This is used for Address filtering when enabled.

spirit:field.spirit:name: mchash
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field contains the bits[15:0] of the 64-bit Multicast Hash Filtering Table. This table is used to perform Multicast Hash filtering for the frames received on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: mchash
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field contains the bits[31:16] of the 64-bit Multicast Hash Filtering Table. This table is used to perform Multicast Hash filtering for the frames received on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: mchash
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field contains the bits[47:32] of the 64-bit Multicast Hash Filtering Table. This table is used to perform Multicast Hash filtering for the frames received on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: mchash
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field contains the bits[63:48] of the 64-bit Multicast Hash Filtering Table. This table is used to perform Multicast Hash filtering for the frames received on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcfrmgen
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This is set by Software for the UMAC to transmit the PAUSE Control frame on this Channel. When this bit is set, the UMAC transmits the PAUSE control frame by using the values programmed in various PAUSE Control specific registers (SA/PAUSE_TIME) on this Channel. Once the PAUSE Control frame is transmitted, the bit is cleared by the UMAC.
The following are the steps for generating the PAUSE Control frame: 1) Read and Verify this bit is cleared. If not cleared wait until the bit is cleared (polling) 2) Program the Pause Frame SA and PAUSE_TIME registers 3) Set this bit. 4) Poll this bit until the bit is cleared.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcdaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the first Byte of the Destination Address field as it appears in the transmitting PAUSE Flow Control Frame or Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcdaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the third Byte of the Destination Address field as it appears in the transmitting PAUSE Flow Control Frame or Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcdaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the fifth Byte of the Destination Address field as it appears in the transmitting PAUSE Flow Control Frame or Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcsaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the first Byte of the Source Address field as it appears in the transmitting PAUSE Flow Control Frame or Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcsaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the third Byte of the Source Address field as it appears in the transmitting PAUSE Flow Control Frame or Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcsaddr
spirit:field.spirit:description: This byte contains the fifth Byte of the Source Address field as it appears in the transmitting PAUSE Flow Control Frame or Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames on this Channel.

spirit:field.spirit:name: fcpausetime
spirit:field.spirit:description: This contains the Pause-Time value that is used in the generated PAUSE Control Frame under software control for this Channel. The 16-bit value is sent out as defined in the IEEE 802.3 Specification with most significant byte first followed by least significant byte.

spirit:field.spirit:name: xoffpausetime
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field contains the Pause-Time value that is used in the generated PAUSE Control Frame when the XOFF PAUSE Frame is to be transmitted. This field is used both in the regular PAUSE flow Control Frames and Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames. The 16-bit value is sent out as defined in the IEEE 802.3 Specification with most significant byte first followed by least significant byte

spirit:field.spirit:name: xonpausetime
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field contains the Pause-Time value that is used in the generated PAUSE Control Frame when the XON PAUSE Frame is to be transmitted. This field is used both in the regular PAUSE flow Control Frames and Priority PAUSE Flow Control Frames. The 16-bit value is sent out as defined in the IEEE 802.3 Specification with most significant byte first followed by least significant byte

spirit:field.spirit:name: tsid
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field contains the Transmit Timestamp ID associated with the Time Stamp that is present in the TimeStamp Value Register.

spirit:field.spirit:name: tsvld
spirit:field.spirit:description: This bit indicates whether the Transmit Timestamp Value Register has valid Value or not. This bit is set when the Timestamp Value register has been loaded with a new Timestamp Value from the TimeStamp FIFO.

spirit:field.spirit:name: ts
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This field contains the bits [15:0] of the TimeStamp Value associated with the TimeStamp ID from the Timestamp Info Register.
When there is no internally latched Timestamp, then this field returns 0xFFFF

spirit:field.spirit:name: ts
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This field contains the bits [31:16] of the TimeStamp Value associated with the TimeStamp ID from the Timestamp Info Register.
When there is no internally latched Timestamp, then this field returns 0xFFFF

spirit:field.spirit:name: ts
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This field contains the bits [47:32] of the TimeStamp Value associated with the TimeStamp ID from the Timestamp Info Register.
When there is no internally latched Timestamp, then this field returns 0xFFFF

spirit:field.spirit:name: ts
spirit:field.spirit:description:
This field contains the bits [63:48] of the TimeStamp Value associated with the TimeStamp ID from the Timestamp Info Register.
When there is no internally latched Timestamp, then this field returns 0xFFFF

spirit:field.spirit:name: txtsdelta
spirit:field.spirit:description: This is the delta value that is subtracted from the latched Tx Timestamp Value before it is passed along with the Frame SOF.

spirit:field.spirit:name: rxtsdelta
spirit:field.spirit:description: This is the delta value that is subtracted from the latched Rx Timestamp Value before it is passed along with the Frame SOF.

spirit:field.spirit:name: minframesize
spirit:field.spirit:description: This field is used to determine the MinFrameSize in Transmit and Receive operation. The MinFrameSize should be programmed with a value which is multiple of 4 and with a minimum value of 32.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txvlantag
spirit:field.spirit:description: This defines the VLAN Tag that is used for comparing and identifying VLAN frames on Transmit Side.

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrdint10
spirit:field.spirit:description: TX underrun Interrupt override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrdint32
spirit:field.spirit:description: TX timestamp fifo overflow override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrdint654
spirit:field.spirit:description: RX Local Fault Interrupt override

spirit:field.spirit:name: slotclkcnt
spirit:field.spirit:description:
When this field is set to zero, the transmit and receive MAC uses internal DataValid/DataReady to count the valid clocks for the Slot Timer Logic. In this mode the Slot is 512 Bit times based on the line rate.
When this field is non-zero, this field determines the number of Clocks (Core_clk_i) for the Slot Timer.
The Slot Timer is used to decrement the PAUSE Quanta.

spirit:field.spirit:name: stompeoperr
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set the EOP/ERR is ignored by the MAC.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txlfault
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set, the MAC continuously transmits L_FAULT ordered set.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txrfault
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set, the MAC continuously transmits R_FAULT ordered set.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txidle
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set, the MAC continuously transmits IDLE Pattern.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txtestpattern
spirit:field.spirit:description: This should be set when the PCS is programmed to transmit Test Pattern. This bit does not have any functionality in the MAC other than in the generation of TX_GOOD signal output.

spirit:field.spirit:name: forcerxxoff
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set, the XOFF (for all priorities) is forced on APP_FIFO Interface when a regular PAUSE frame is received and the Transmit MAC is not disabled. When clear, normal PAUSE frame reception behavior of disabling TxMAC

spirit:field.spirit:name: txautodraintxdisable
spirit:field.spirit:description: TxAutoDrainonTxDisable: When set, the TxAutoDrain function is enabled when the TXMAC is disabled (TXEnable is set to 1'b0). When clear, the frames are not drained when the MAC is disabled.

spirit:field.spirit:name: macdebug0
spirit:field.spirit:description: MAC Debug #0. This should be treated as reserved and not modified by User.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txvlantagena
spirit:field.spirit:description: This enables the VLAN Tag comparison and identification of VLAN frames on Transmit Side

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrdtxdisonpause
spirit:field.spirit:description: When set, the TxDisable on RxPause function is overridden. The Tx Is not disabled, but the signal ff_Rxfcxoff signal is generated on the APP_FIFO Interface. When cleared, the normal Pause function is enabled where the TXMAC is disabled for the duration of PAUSE Time.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txfullthres4ch
spirit:field.spirit:description: FIFO Almost Full Threshold in 4 Channel Mode This determines the maximum number of Additional Valid Strobes that the Application can generate (FIFO DEPTH - Threshold Value) after the FIFO Almost Full is asserted (ff_txafullN_o) in FIFO based protocol. This is assuming that the Minimum Sized frame on the Application Interface is 17Bytes or more (SOF and EOF not on the same clock) The range of legal values are 2 to 12.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txfullthres2ch
spirit:field.spirit:description: FIFO Almost Full Threshold in 2 Channel Mode This determines the maximum number of Additional Valid Strobes that the Application can generate (FIFO DEPTH - Threshold Value) after the FIFO Almost Full is asserted (ff_txafullN_o) in FIFO based protocol. This is assuming that the Minimum Sized frame on the Application Interface is 17Bytes or more (SOF and EOF not on the same clock) The range of legal values are 2 to 28.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txfullthres1ch
spirit:field.spirit:description: FIFO Almost Full Threshold in 1 Channel Mode This determines the maximum number of Additional Valid Strobes that the Application can generate (FIFO DEPTH - Threshold Value) after the FIFO Almost Full is asserted (ff_txafullN_o) in FIFO based protocol. This is assuming that the Minimum Sized frame on the Application Interface is 17Bytes or more (SOF and EOF not on the same clock) The range of legal values are 2 to 60.

spirit:field.spirit:name: s2chmapena
spirit:field.spirit:description: When this bit is set, the FIFO_ARB generates the Channel Cycling based on the programmable mapping. When this is reset, the Channel cycling is based on the Global Mode and Global Mode#2 values. This Channel Cycling is used to read write APP_FIFO in TX and RX direction respectively (between the APP_FIFO and MC_MAC Interface).

spirit:field.spirit:name: usepingpongbuff
spirit:field.spirit:description: When this bit is set, it is used to implement the Ping-pong buffer scheme in programming the Slot to Channel Mapping in the TxArb Module. When reset, the programmed Slot to Channel Mapping values are used directly.

spirit:field.spirit:name: updatechmapping
spirit:field.spirit:description: Write to this register with a value of all 1's confirms the new Slot to Channel Mapping values. The Hardware will load the programmed Slot to Channel Values into its internal Registers upon write to this register. This is a write only register from software and read from this register returns all zeros.

spirit:field.spirit:name: ench0
spirit:field.spirit:description: Setting this bit enables the Loopback on the MAC's FIFO Interface for Channel#0. The Receive frames are looped back on to the transmit MAC module for this Channel#N. When this loopback is enabled, the data received from the Application/Application logic is ignored for Channel#o.

spirit:field.spirit:name: ench1
spirit:field.spirit:description: Setting this bit enables the Loopback on the MAC's FIFO Interface for Channel#1. The Receive frames are looped back on to the transmit MAC module for this Channel#N. When this loopback is enabled, the data received from the Application/Application logic is ignored for Channel#1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: ench2
spirit:field.spirit:description: Setting this bit enables the Loopback on the MAC's FIFO Interface for Channel#2. The Receive frames are looped back on to the transmit MAC module for this Channel#N. When this loopback is enabled, the data received from the Application/Application logic is ignored for Channel#2.

spirit:field.spirit:name: ench3
spirit:field.spirit:description: Setting this bit enables the Loopback on the MAC's FIFO Interface for Channel#3. The Receive frames are looped back on to the transmit MAC module for this Channel#N. When this loopback is enabled, the data received from the Application/Application logic is ignored for Channel#3.

spirit:field.spirit:name: appfifolpthrsh
spirit:field.spirit:description: In the FIFO Loopback mode, this determines the number of entries to be present in the Transmit FIFO before the frames are being transmitted out. This is to avoid Underun on Transmit as the Receive stream might have Alignment patterns, etc.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap0
spirit:field.spirit:description: The value defines the port# which is mapped to Ch#0.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap1
spirit:field.spirit:description: The value defines the port# which is mapped to Ch#1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap2
spirit:field.spirit:description: The value defines the port# which is mapped to Ch#2.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap3
spirit:field.spirit:description: The value defines the port# which is mapped to Ch#3.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap0ena
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable APP FIFO Port Map #0 field.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap1ena
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable APP FIFO Port Map #1 field.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap2ena
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable APP FIFO Port Map #2 field.

spirit:field.spirit:name: portmap3ena
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable APP FIFO Port Map #3 field.

spirit:field.spirit:name: sofmingap0
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Gap between Consecutive SOFs on Same Channel, in presence of Short Packets

spirit:field.spirit:name: enminframepadding0
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable Rx Frame Padding to MinFrame Size

spirit:field.spirit:name: minframepadding0
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Frame Size for Padding (Multiple of 16 Bytes)

spirit:field.spirit:name: sofmingap1
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Gap between Consecutive SOFs on Same Channel, in presence of Short Packets

spirit:field.spirit:name: enminframepadding1
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable Rx Frame Padding to MinFrame Size

spirit:field.spirit:name: minframepadding1
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Frame Size for Padding (Multiple of 16 Bytes)

spirit:field.spirit:name: sofmingap2
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Gap between Consecutive SOFs on Same Channel, in presence of Short Packets

spirit:field.spirit:name: enminframepadding2
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable Rx Frame Padding to MinFrame Size

spirit:field.spirit:name: minframepadding2
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Frame Size for Padding (Multiple of 16 Bytes)

spirit:field.spirit:name: sofmingap3
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Gap between Consecutive SOFs on Same Channel, in presence of Short Packets

spirit:field.spirit:name: enminframepadding3
spirit:field.spirit:description: Enable Rx Frame Padding to MinFrame Size

spirit:field.spirit:name: minframepadding3
spirit:field.spirit:description: Min Frame Size for Padding (Multiple of 16 Bytes)

spirit:field.spirit:name: txthreshold0
spirit:field.spirit:description: The field indicates the threshold which is used by APP_FIFO before reading out the data from TX_FIFO and sending it to MAC. When the FIFO Fill level is equal to or greater than the Threshold value or EOF is seen, then the FIFO is read out and sent to MAC. To Avoid deadlock, this value should never be greater than the (FIFO_DEPTH-SEL_AFULLTHRESH-N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS). Here, FIFO_DEPTH = Depth of the FIFO associated with Ch#0, SEL_AFULLTHRES = Selected Almost Full Threshold for Ch#0 and N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS = Number of Additional Valids that APP Logic generates after the assertion of TxAfull on Ch#0.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txthreshold1
spirit:field.spirit:description: The field indicates the threshold which is used by APP_FIFO before reading out the data from TX_FIFO and sending it to MAC. When the FIFO Fill level is equal to or greater than the Threshold value or EOF is seen, then the FIFO is read out and sent to MAC. To Avoid deadlock, this value should never be greater than the (FIFO_DEPTH-SEL_AFULLTHRESH-N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS). Here, FIFO_DEPTH = Depth of the FIFO associated with Ch#0, SEL_AFULLTHRES = Selected Almost Full Threshold for Ch#0 and N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS = Number of Additional Valids that APP Logic generates after the assertion of TxAfull on Ch#1.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txthreshold2
spirit:field.spirit:description: The field indicates the threshold which is used by APP_FIFO before reading out the data from TX_FIFO and sending it to MAC. When the FIFO Fill level is equal to or greater than the Threshold value or EOF is seen, then the FIFO is read out and sent to MAC. To Avoid deadlock, this value should never be greater than the (FIFO_DEPTH-SEL_AFULLTHRESH-N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS). Here, FIFO_DEPTH = Depth of the FIFO associated with Ch#0, SEL_AFULLTHRES = Selected Almost Full Threshold for Ch#0 and N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS = Number of Additional Valids that APP Logic generates after the assertion of TxAfull on Ch#2.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txthreshold3
spirit:field.spirit:description: The field indicates the threshold which is used by APP_FIFO before reading out the data from TX_FIFO and sending it to MAC. When the FIFO Fill level is equal to or greater than the Threshold value or EOF is seen, then the FIFO is read out and sent to MAC. To Avoid deadlock, this value should never be greater than the (FIFO_DEPTH-SEL_AFULLTHRESH-N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS). Here, FIFO_DEPTH = Depth of the FIFO associated with Ch#0, SEL_AFULLTHRES = Selected Almost Full Threshold for Ch#0 and N_ADDITIONAL_TXVALIDS = Number of Additional Valids that APP Logic generates after the assertion of TxAfull on Ch#3.

spirit:field.spirit:name: slot0chmap
spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#0

spirit:field.spirit:name: slot1chmap
spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#1

spirit:field.spirit:name: slot2chmap
spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#2

spirit:field.spirit:name: slot3chmap
spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#3

spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#4

spirit:field.spirit:name: slot5chmap
spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#5

spirit:field.spirit:name: slot6chmap
spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#6

spirit:field.spirit:name: slot7chmap
spirit:field.spirit:description: Channel Number to be used for Slot#7

spirit:field.spirit:name: rxparityen
spirit:field.spirit:description: This bit when set, enables the parity Protection on the RX APP_FIFO. When cleared, the Parity check is not performed.

spirit:field.spirit:name: txparityen
spirit:field.spirit:description: This bit when set, enables the parity Protection on the TX APP_FIFO. When cleared, the Parity check is not performed.

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int0
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#0 RX Fifo Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int1
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#0 TX Fifo Overflow Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int2
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#0 TX Fifo DCNT Protocol Violation Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int3
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#0 TX Fifo SOF/EOF Protocol Violation Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int4
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#1 RX Fifo Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int5
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#1 TX Fifo Overflow Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int6
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#1 TX Fifo DCNT Protocol Violation Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int7
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#1 TX Fifo SOF/EOF Protocol Violation Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int8
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#2 RX Fifo Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int9
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#2 TX Fifo Overflow Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int10
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#2 TX Fifo DCNT Protocol Violation Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int11
spirit:field.spirit:description: Fifoctrl Ch#2 TX Fifo SOF/EOF Protocol Violation Error Interrupt Override

spirit:field.spirit:name: ovrd0int12
